out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located next to the 3 vat sink is blocked by a chair, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. CDI: CFM relocated the chair from in front of the hand sink next to the 3 vat sink.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw shelled eggs stored above shredded green cabbage on shelves inside the Tafco walk in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CDI: CFM relocated the raw shelled eggs to the bottom shelf inside the Tafco walk in refrigerator.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: plastic squeeze bottles and containers of spices, herbs, sauces, oil, water on the prep and cookline throughout the main kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EHS instructed CFM to place common food label name on all food items removed from original container in the main kitchen.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Plastic containers of food stored on the floor inside the walk in refrigerator and freezer in the main kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. CDI: CFM relocated the plastic containers of food to a shelf inside the walk in refrigerator and freezer in the main kitchen. OISO KOREAN STREET FOOD (Inspection Date: 11/04/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: aluminum foil and greasy news paper lining carts shelves and aluminum foil lining cart legs on the cookline in the main kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. EHS instructed CFM to remove aluminum foil and news paper from the cart shelves and aluminum foil from the cart legs on the cookline in the main kitchen.

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Durable Materials
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not resistant to corrosion: three soy sauce bulk buckets used to store dry food items (dry white rice, flour, etc) in the main kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be resistant to pitting, chipping, crazing, scratching, scoring, distortion, and decomposition.

violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC MOVED EQUIPMENT.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: Observed an employee wash a food container and go to put away without sanitizing the container.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. EHS EXPLAINED PROPER WARE WASHING AND EMPLOYEE SANITIZED CONTAINER.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 70F, No More than 2 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours: fried squid 75F and noodles wrapped in seaweed 72F after 2.5 hours.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. PIC DISCARDED FOOD.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Pesticides labeled for residential use were observed in the facility and are being applied by the operator to control pests. OBSERVED BOTTLE OF RAID IN THE KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. PIC DISCARDED RAID.

violations.title: Cleaning Procedure
violations.observation: Observed food employees using improper handwashing procedures. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE WASH THEIR HANDS WITH A GLOVE ON.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wash their hands and exposed portions of their arms by: 1) discarding used gloves; 2) rinsing under warm running water; 3) applying soap; 4) rubbing together for at least 10-15 seconds; 5) rinsing thoroughly under warm running water; and 6) drying with paper towels or air drying device. EHS EXPLAINED PROPER HAND WASHING PROCEDURE AND HAD THE EMPLOYEE WASH THEIR HANDS CORRECTLY.

violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee was observed cleaning their hands in a food preparation sink, warewashing sink or in a mop sink. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE WASH THEIR HANDS AT THE PREP SINK.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. EHS EXPLAINED THAT HANDS CAN ONLY BE WASHED AT THE HAND SINK AND HAD EMPLOYEE WASH THEIR HANDS AT THE HAND SINK.
